request: Build a checkers game in a single HTML file - complete and feature-rich. 8x8 board, 12 red pieces and 12 black pieces, alternating turns. Full standard rules: pieces move diagonally forward one square, capture by jumping diagonally forward (mandatory captures), multi-jump capture chains in a single turn, kings that move and capture in all four diagonal directions, win detection (no legal moves or no pieces) with a winner banner, and a score tracker across multiple games. Also include: a minimax AI opponent with easy/medium/hard difficulty levels you can toggle, undo/redo buttons, legal-move highlighting when a piece is selected, a move history log, capture and move sound effects using the Web Audio API, CSS animations for piece movement and captures, a dark theme with custom piece colors, and touch support. Write EVERYTHING in this one HTML file with clear, heavily-commented JavaScript. The file must be complete and work when opened in a browser.

intent.goal: checkers game in a single HTML file - complete and feature-rich.

planFiles.summary: The single HTML file containing the entire checkers game, including the HTML structure, CSS styles, and JavaScript logic.
